description: This Java class defines a SearchEntry model that encapsulates an index product and associated highlights, used in a search feature within the project.

classes.name: SearchEntry
classes.description: A model class representing a search result entry containing an indexed product and highlight snippets.

methods.name: setHighlights
methods.description: Sets the list of highlight snippets for this search entry.

methods.name: getHighlights
methods.description: Retrieves the list of highlight snippets.

methods.name: setIndexProduct
methods.description: Sets the index product associated with this search entry.

methods.name: getIndexProduct
methods.description: Retrieves the index product associated with this search entry.
